question:
The given pie chart shows the share of labour, raw material, energy, transportation cost, and plant & machinery in the total manufacturing cost of the company during a particular year. Study the pie chart and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc2edd5b866355b02179770afa38c44f020aa277ebe1376cc162c9826fbdf546.png] 

The total central angle showing the share of energy, labor, and transportation cost in the total manufacturing cost during the year was:
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc2edd5b866355b02179770afa38c44f020aa277ebe1376cc162c9826fbdf546.png] 

**Concept used:**

Considering 360° as 100%

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Total central angle showing the share of energy, labor, and transportation cost,

⇒ Energy% + Labour% + Transportation%

⇒ (30% + 10% + 10%) of 360° 

⇒ Angle = 40% × 360° 

⇒ Angle = 4 × 36° = 144° 

**∴ The total central angle is 144°.**
